_comment: Heterogeneous real-RTL schedule: mlp_control + dronet on FireSim quad-rocket-saturn with two scheduled cores — cpu_p=RVV (vector-enabled) and cpu_e=scalar (no vector). Both target=firesim_rocket_saturn, profile derived from the multi-model pool-sweep harness for each TARGET. Each scheduled machine is a single hart (topo_0); per-kind pthreadpools side-step the parallelize-overhead trap we saw with one shared 4-core pool, since each machine just runs sequentially within its dispatch.
